name: Mimas
tagline: Saturn's 'Death Star' moon — a battered ice ball dominated by the giant Herschel crater.
history: One crater, Herschel, spans a third of Mimas's diameter — an impact that nearly shattered the moon and gave it an unmistakable Death Star silhouette. Despite the violent look, Mimas is quiet ice; Cassini measured an odd libration wobble that hints either at a subsurface ocean or a misshapen frozen core — a puzzle still debated. Its clearing of the Cassini Division gap in Saturn's rings shows how a small moon sculpts a grand system.
